I am a 34-year-old woman farming here in Oromia. This small 0.24 hectare plot is not mine — I rent it — so I must be careful how much money I put into it. I grow something other than the main grains on this piece, and I manage with my family's hands mostly. My husband and I have a little livestock so I can carry some manure to the field, but buying fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and the supply comes late. I will put a small amount of DAP if I can get it, rely mostly on manure, and use the seed I saved from last season since improved seed for this crop is hard to find in our kebele.
